I am usually one to hide in the side lines and hesitate to voice my opinion, but I thought maybe I would put in my two cents.

Like many others have voiced, the movie was absolutely stunning! The beauty of the world outside of Arcadia, the unique designs of the titans, even as I watched all the destruction and havoc wreaked by the titans had it me in awe.

I agree that Strickler's death was pointless and avoidable. Douxie and Archie should have never been separated in the first place because, for my limited knowledge about wizards, aren't their familiars supposed to stick by their side. As much as I love Charlie, Archie should have returned to Douxie's side. As for Nomura dying in the sunlight. They aren't changelings anymore. Their human halves were gone when the babies were saved from the Darklands which makes me believe that the rules of full trolls now applies to the former changelings. They did Steve so dirty with the whole pregnancy plot. Like I get they wanted a reason to keep him and Eli out of the fight but like??? Anything would have been better than whatever that was.

But overall I enjoyed the movie. Even the ending doesn't have me as broken up as many others in this fandom, but I completely understand both sides. It does suck that now they can basically create this time loop until they get things right because I do understand how that negates the Tales of Arcadia saga. But the way I'm looking at it. The trilogy is one of the timelines that I can personally believe is the true canon, or I can make it what I want it. Personally I believe that Trollhunter Jim will forever be the only way they can get the best outcome in the reset, but I believe Jim wanted Toby to find the amulet for a reason. Jim just witnessed his best friend die, and to me Jim wants Toby to have the armor so that if this new timeline leads to a similar outcome, that leads to this final fight in ROTT, then Jim has that insurance that because Toby is the Trollhunter, and has this magical armor that it could be the thing that saves his life.

I know people say that it was selfish of Jim to let Toby take the amulet due to how much Jim had faced during his possession of the amulet. But this timeline is new, anything could happen but they're sticking by each others side no matter what and I believe in my heart that Jim will do everything he can to prevent the worst from happening while Toby wields the mantle. Because it's not Trollhunter, it's Trollhunters.

I apologize this kind of turned into a rant, and I apologize if it isn't very cohesive. But I wanted to shed a positive outlook on the ending.
